youtube.title: He Declared Himself Emperor Of The USA (True Story) 👑
youtube.description:
On 17 September 1859 Joshua Norton, a San Francisco merchant who had lost his fortune trying to corner the rice market, sent the newspapers a proclamation declaring himself Emperor of these United States. The Bulletin printed it, and the city played along for the next twenty years.

Norton I wore a blue army uniform with gold epaulettes and a hat with a peacock feather, issued his own banknotes that local businesses accepted, and decreed that Congress was abolished (Congress ignored him). When a police officer arrested him in 1867, the public outcry was so loud that the police chief released him with an apology, and from then on officers saluted him in the street. He also ordered a bridge built across San Francisco Bay; the Bay Bridge opened in 1936. When he died in 1880, thousands lined the streets for his funeral.
